label: A7
title: Book vocabulary list: more words
summary: The 493 words in the book's Tagalog–English Vocabulary List (pages 208 to 213) that are not taught in any lesson, as flashcards
goals: Learn the extra everyday words from the book's Vocabulary List
Use the Book list in the Words tab to look up any word

blocks.t: At the back of the book (pages 208 to 218) there are two Vocabulary Lists: Tagalog to English and English to Tagalog. You can browse and search both, exactly as printed, in **Words › Book list**.

This section turns the words from the Tagalog to English list that no lesson teaches into flashcards, so they can go into your review deck like any other word. Each entry is copied exactly as the book prints it, including the part of speech (*n.* noun, *v.* verb, *adj.* adjective, *adv.* adverb, *interj.* interjection) and any related words given with it.

blocks.title: No accent marks
blocks.t: The Vocabulary List prints almost every word **without accent marks**, so these cards have no stress guide. Where a lesson teaches the same word you will find it there with its accents; the book list marks those with a green dot.
